variables.text: The experiment varied materials, geometries, preheating, and flow configurations.
variables.quote: Assess the effectiveness of an inert, gaseous extinguishing agent (similar to that used on ISS) in putting out flames over different materials, geometries, preheating, and flow.

measurements.text: Data was collected on flame size, shape, color, spread rate, and potential flame quenching through observations of top and edge profiles.
